newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee to sell JP stake.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee to sell JP stake.

text.p: JP Foodservice Inc said Sara Lee Corp is exercising its rights to sell a 27.7 percent stake in JP Foodservice or about 6.1 million shares of stock.
Under its registration rights agreement with Sara Lee, JP Foodservice said it is obligated to file a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the stock offering.
Sara Lee's stake in JP Foodservice may first be sold to the public on November 23, 1996. JP Foodservice has about 22.2 million shares outstanding.
JP Foodservice said the registration of shares is a continuation of Sara Lee's efforts to exit the food service business after the company acquired JP in 1989.
JP "supports Sara Lee's decision to register and sell its shares, and we will be working closely with Sara Lee throughout this process to assure its success," the company said.
Sara Lee and JP have had a long-standing relationship since the inception of JP, and Sara Lee will remain a major supplier to JP, it said.
